Return the data for all Medical Records Details

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter MedicalRecordsRequest records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter MedicalRecordsRequest records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of Medical Records Detail records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: treatment_end_date
params.description: Filters Medical Records data by treatment end date.

params.name: treatment_start_date
params.description: Filters Medical Records data by treatment start date.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter MedicalRecordsRequest records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

info.name: Creating a Medical Records Detail, Medical Records and Medical Bills

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

items.docs:
This endpoint allows a creation of a Medical Records Detail, multiple Medical Records and Medical Bills.
Medical Liens can also be created as a property under Medical Bills.

Reference the payload to see how the records are being passed in.

will also be destroyed in the same transaction.
